title: Tedesco brothers' data on orbs entering the water off Long Island

tellings.quote: They have some serious data of orbs off offshore. Some going into the water

plain: Two brothers, Jerry Tedesco and John Tedesco, are said to have gathered serious data on glowing orbs flying off the coast of Long Island, New York, some of them going down into the water. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral, mentions their work as something he knows of from them. He tells it as part of his case that unexplained objects move in and out of the ocean.
